fusions.name: Silk Line
fusions.desc: Spins a strand to a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Anchor Thread
fusions.desc: Fires strands at every enemy within 3.5 tiles at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, dealing 7 damage to each.

fusions.name: Dew-Strung Trap
fusions.desc: Strings a web trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 2 minutes, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 24 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Loom Watch
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded spider of your own hair that fights beside you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
